question: Mirza Hakim was the half-brother of which of these Mughal emperors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Akbar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shahzada Mirza Muhammad Hakim** (29 April 1553 – 10 October 1585), known as** Mirza Hakim **and was the **third son** of the **Mughal emperor Humayun.**
 
• He is the son of Mah Chuchak Begum and the half-brother of emperor Akbar.
 
• He ruled Kabul in Afghanistan, and often conflicted with his elder brother, Emperor Akbar but later mended his relations.
 
• He is known for writing** Tajdar-e-Haram.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Aurangzeb**

 
 
• Aurangzeb is also known as **Alamgir.**
 
• He was the sixth emperor of the Mughal Empire, ruling from July 1658 until his death in 1707.
 
• Under his emperorship, the Mughals reached their greatest extent with their territory spanning nearly the entire South Asia.
 
• **He was the son of Shahjahan.**
 
 
 
• **​​Jahangir**
 
 
• ​Jahangir was the fourth Mughal Emperor, who ruled from 1605 until his death in 1627.
 
• He was called **Salim **by his father Akbar and was the third son born to Akbar and his favourite Queen Zamani in Fatehpur Sikri on 31 August 1569.
 
 
 
• **​Shah Jahan**
 
 
• ​Shah Jahan, was the** fifth emperor **of the Mughal Empire, reigning from January 1628 until July 1658.
 
• Under his emperorship, the Mughals reached the peak of their architectural achievements and cultural glory.
